why: The assistant use case: a persona with real file tools on a scratch folder is asked to build a one-page site from a brief in a read-only folder, adds a section on request, is asked to write outside its folders and says what it could not do. The outcome is files, checked by code.

files.name: brief.txt
files.text:
Rye and Ember Bakery: brief for a one-page website

Name: Rye and Ember Bakery
Tagline: Slow bread, baked at dawn.
Colours: warm cream #f6ead6 for the background and dark brown #3b2a20 for the text.
Sections, in this order: About, Menu, Opening hours, Contact.
About: A two-person bakery on Mill Lane that bakes everything with a thirty-year-old rye starter.
Menu: Seeded rye loaf, 4.20 pounds. Cinnamon bun, 2.80 pounds. Cardamom knot, 3.10 pounds.
Opening hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 7:00 to 15:00. Closed on Mondays.
Contact: hello@ryeandember.example

why: The same task with the file tools on the game master instead of the character: who ends up doing the file work, and whether the page is as good.
